sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण पर्वतो मैथिलीम् प्रति ।दर्शयन् इव ताम् सीताम् न दर्शयत राघवे ॥३-६४-३२॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa parvato maithilīm prati ।darśayan iva tām sītām na darśayata rāghave ॥3-64-32॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rama, the mountain echoed as if it was telling about Sita but did not show her to Rama.
